source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Reflecting the maximum dose of an antibiotic that would still be considered safe for the client to receive","B":"The lowest concentration of an antibiotic that inhibits visible growth of the organism, helping guide appropriate antibiotic selection","C":"A value generally considered to carry fairly little connection to how an appropriate antibiotic is actually selected","D":"Reflecting the organism's overall resistance level, without providing any further clinically useful detail beyond that"}}
source_row.rationale: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) represents the lowest concentration of an antibiotic that inhibits visible growth of a specific organism in laboratory testing, helping guide appropriate antibiotic selection based on the organism's susceptibility profile.
source_row.source_name: Clinical Laboratory Standards Institute — MIC Testing Interpretation
